confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Japanese pricing; no menus, listings, or booking pages were inspected. Restaurant and cafe anchors are the more reliable ones. Hostel and hotel anchors vary with season, weekday, and event demand, so they are less certain. Values assume roughly 150 yen per US dollar; a large yen move would shift all USD anchors. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against draft beer price relationships because direct local knowledge is thinner.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional Japanese city basis: a mid-sized, tourist-visited city in western Honshu, with accommodation priced below Tokyo, Osaka, and Kyoto and food and drink at typical Japanese regional levels. No single named comparison city was used.
